extends RefCounted
## Integer-only simulation sample for the ADR-008 section e guard.
## Every value below is int or PackedInt64Array, never a float.

const FX_ONE: int = 1000
const HIT_LABEL: String = "100%"

var hp: int = 12000
var damage: int = 2500
var position: PackedInt64Array = PackedInt64Array([0, 0])
var velocity: PackedInt64Array = PackedInt64Array([0, 0])


static func damage_after(hp_value: int, damage_value: int) -> int:
	# 1.5 / 2 in a comment stays outside the scan.
	return maxi(hp_value - Fx.mul(damage_value, FX_ONE), 0)


static func step_position(pos: PackedInt64Array, vel: PackedInt64Array) -> PackedInt64Array:
	pos[0] = clampi(pos[0] + vel[0], -Fx.COORD_MAX, Fx.COORD_MAX)
	pos[1] = clampi(pos[1] + vel[1], -Fx.COORD_MAX, Fx.COORD_MAX)
	return pos


static func signed_scale(value: int, factor: int) -> int:
	return Fx.mul_sym(value, factor)


static func short_span(first: int, second: int) -> int:
	var lower: int = mini(first, second)
	var upper: int = maxi(first, second)
	var magnitude: int = absi(upper - lower)
	var direction: int = signi(upper - lower)
	return Fx.floor_div(magnitude * direction, FX_ONE)
